text: {"lessons":["I sold several positions after gains early on; I should decide whether to sell based on their prospects and my portfolio plan, not the pleasure of locking in a gain.","The account rose overall while I made no trades for many months, reminding me that frequent action is not necessary when prices are unpredictable.","I should judge each holding by its future risk and return, not by its average cost or whether selling would realize a loss."]}
